red_team.countercase: The most concerning case is LPSY/redistribution, not accumulation. Three pieces of supporting evidence: (1) macro structure prints a lower high at 4254 vs the 4955 ATH, anchoring overhead supply; (2) ETH/BTC has put in 5 consecutive lower weekly closes from 0.030967 -> 0.028248, showing institutional money is preferring BTC; (3) the sequence of upper-band rejections at 2466 -> 2425 -> 2424 is a shortening-of-thrust pattern, classic LPSY behavior. If the next rejection at the Creek prints with strong volume and breaks 2150, the entire Phase B is a redistribution and the prior 1742.79 SC was an absorption stop on the way to a deeper markdown.
